skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and role of social media, analyze risks and legal regulations, and develop marketing strategies using social media platforms.
Analyze business data and information from social media, and develop strategies for social media marketing.
Manage social media content and platforms for business activities.
Analyze business applications of social media and develop appropriate social media solutions for different business functions and communities.
Develop communication skills through social media, and work independently and in teams.
Develop independent learning and research skills, and solve problems related to social media.
Adapt to different social media platforms and work environments, and collaborate effectively in group activities.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems related to social media.
Manage projects related to social media marketing and business applications.
Understand and comply with legal regulations related to social media.
